title: Kirtland security meeting with Benowitz where attendees leave
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: he told me by the end of the meet everybody started leaving and by the end of the meeting there was like three or four people left because they're like oh that's not ours.

plain: In 1980, Paul Bennewitz, a New Mexico man convinced he was picking up signs of alien activity, presented what he had to a meeting at Kirtland Air Force Base. People kept walking out, saying "oh, that's not ours," until only three or four were left. The writer Greg Bishop tells this from what Tom Deuley, who was there, told him. The point would be that each group in the room was checking whether the strange things were its own secret projects.
